notes.title: More help, speech options, and a bugfix!
notes.notes:
Hello, you!

I've been using BOTH of my listening ears to listen to feedback! And so today I released a big update!

In version 1.2.1 you'll get

[list]
[*] A fix for one of the waveforms that could be got two ways but only gave a hint for one of the ways and that way was bugged ːsteamfacepalmː (You have been judged worthy by Judgement itself)
[*] An audio option to disable the speech sounds, in case they irk you. Some of us are easily irked by beepy blippy sounds, so now there's an option. Irk. That's a great word!
[*] A quest journal! Especially in the early areas as you get used to the world, it can be a little confusing if you've spoken to someone and forgotten where to go or what they said. So now there's a Quest Journal to remind you of what's happened in Hus and potential ways to move forward. It's totally optional so if you still want to play without help, you can!
[/list]

And that's all the things. Thank you again for supporting my silly little game!

notes.title: Small waveform fix
notes.notes:
Happy Saturday everyone!

Small update today, one of the waveforms was bugged and didn't set when you did the thing ːsteamsadː

So if you're trying to get "Join the old gods" and you've been in a certain tower and said you'd join three distinctly coloured characters... sorry you'll need to do it again for the waveform to register. Bumnoise.

notes.title: Little physics issue fix, and a simpler faer mission
notes.notes:
Hiya luvs!

Just a quick update. Oh boy you lot are great at finding things I need to fix!

So this fixes a little issue on slower systems where it was possible to fall off the edge of the screen in some locations.

And it makes finding that last faer in the marketplace _much_ easier and nicer to play as your first mission in the game!

notes.title: Small fixes and big hints!
notes.notes: [p]Version 1.1.73 is released![/p][p]It fixes a few typos, and "Continue" is no longer an option if it would just take you to the boring credits screen. Unless you REALLY want to watch that over and over??[/p][p]ALSO! It adds hints for each waveform! AND! Once you've completed your first run through the story, all of them get unhidden![/p][p]OK BYE[/p]

notes.title: Quick hint update!
notes.notes:
So a few folk have said they get a bit lost in the early part of the game. Yeah, it just dumps you into the world and says "Hey, get on with it!"

So now a few of the characters give you better hints, like where to go with your new abilities and where to look for that final missing faer...
